# GTA 6 Map

> Interactive GTA 6 map of Leonida (Grand Theft Auto VI) covering Vice City, Leonida Keys, Grassrivers, Port Gellhorn, Ambrosia, and Mount Kalaga.

This site is an unofficial fan atlas. It is not affiliated with Rockstar Games.

## Primary pages
- [GTA 6 map](https://gta-6-map.com/): Interactive Leonida atlas with searchable pins
- [GTA 6 map guide](https://gta-6-map.com/guide/): Direct answers, FAQ, and every region
- [Vice City](https://gta-6-map.com/regions/vice-city/): The urban core of the GTA 6 map — beaches, grid, and port on the Leonida coast.
- [Leonida Keys](https://gta-6-map.com/regions/leonida-keys/): Island chain south of Vice City on the Grand Theft Auto VI map.
- [Grassrivers](https://gta-6-map.com/regions/grassrivers/): Wetland region on the GTA 6 map, inland of the gulf coast.
- [Port Gellhorn](https://gta-6-map.com/regions/port-gellhorn/): Gulf-side town on the western Leonida shoreline.
- [Ambrosia](https://gta-6-map.com/regions/ambrosia/): Inland Leonida country around Lake Leonida and cane fields.
- [Mount Kalaga](https://gta-6-map.com/regions/mount-kalaga/): Northern high ground on the published GTA 6 map of Leonida.

## Categories
- [Points of Interest](https://gta-6-map.com/categories/points-of-interest/): ATMs, gyms, clubs, and Ammu-Nation.
- [Robberies](https://gta-6-map.com/categories/robberies/): Banks, jewelers, stores, safes, and towable ATMs.
- [Vehicles](https://gta-6-map.com/categories/vehicles/): Garages, gas, transit, and standout vehicles.
- [Style](https://gta-6-map.com/categories/style/): Clothes, tattoos, hair, and electronics.
- [Food & Drink](https://gta-6-map.com/categories/food-and-drink/): Cafes, bars, and street food.
- [WAiNK Locations](https://gta-6-map.com/categories/waink-locations/): Landmarks, curiosities, and sculptures.
- [Exploration](https://gta-6-map.com/categories/exploration/): Book swaps, magazines, playlists, and 1010 murals.
- [Collectible Cards](https://gta-6-map.com/categories/collectible-cards/): Jack of Hearts, Delights, and Nine1Nine cards.
- [Sports](https://gta-6-map.com/categories/sports/): Basketball, golf, mini-golf, and pool.
- [Activities](https://gta-6-map.com/categories/activities/): Shooting ranges, arcades, and fishing hotspots.
- [Stunts](https://gta-6-map.com/categories/stunts/): Stunt jumps, base jumps, knife flights, and bridges.
- [Racing](https://gta-6-map.com/categories/racing/): Street races, circuits, and drone races.
- [Illegal Operations](https://gta-6-map.com/categories/illegal-operations/): Crew hideouts and criminal spots.
- [Sitemap](https://gta-6-map.com/sitemap.xml)

- Product name: GTA 6 Map
- Game: Grand Theft Auto VI (GTA 6)
- Setting: Leonida
- Published regions: Vice City, Leonida Keys, Grassrivers, Port Gellhorn, Ambrosia, Mount Kalaga
- Features: satellite and atlas sheets, region filters, search, shareable pin URLs, local field notes
- Status: unofficial fan map; not an official Rockstar map
